q.q: Which letter is 4th to the right of the 12th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
q.x: The 12th letter is L. Moving 4 places to the right (L=12, 12+4=16) gives the 16th letter, which is P? No, 12+4 = 16. The 16th letter is P. Let's re-verify: L(12), M(13), N(14), O(15), P(16). Wait, 4th to the right of 12 is 16. Correct is P.

q.q: If the word 'DIPLOMA' is coded as 'EJQMPNB', how is 'STUDENT' coded?
q.x: Each letter is shifted by +1. Therefore, S+1=T, T+1=U, U+1=V, D+1=E, E+1=F, N+1=O, T+1=U.

q.q: If it is possible to make only one meaningful word with the second, sixth, ninth, and twelfth letters of the word 'METROPOLITAN', which of the following will be the third letter of that word?
q.x: Letters are E (2nd), O (6th), I (9th), N (12th). The letters are E, O, I, N. No meaningful word can be formed. If the question implies 'L' is the 12th letter in METROPOLITAN, check: M1 E2 T3 R4 O5 P6 O7 L8 I9 T10 A11 N12. The letters are E, P, I, N. Still no word.

q.q: Find the next term in the series: AZ, CX, EV, GT, ...
q.x: The first letters follow +2 (A, C, E, G -> I). The second letters follow -2 (Z, X, V, T -> R). Result is IR.

q.q: If the word 'BRAIN' is coded as 'CSBJO', how is 'PLANT' coded using the same logic?
q.x: Each letter is shifted by +1. P+1=Q, L+1=M, A+1=B, N+1=O, T+1=U.

q.q: In the word 'TERMINAL', if each vowel is replaced by the next letter in the alphabet and each consonant is replaced by the previous letter, what is the new word formed?
q.x: T-1=S, E+1=F, R-1=Q, M-1=L, I+1=J, N-1=M, A+1=B, L-1=K. The resulting word is SQ L J M B K, adjusted per rules.

q.q: Which letter comes 4th to the right of the letter which is 15th from the right end of the English alphabet?
q.x: 15th from the right is L. 4th to the right of L is P. Alternatively, 15 - 4 = 11th from the right, which is P.

q.q: In the word 'DETERMINATION', how many pairs of letters have the same number of letters between them as in the English alphabet?
q.x: Checking pairs: D-E (1), D-I (5), R-T (1), N-O (1). There are 4 such pairs satisfying the condition.

q.q: Which letter is exactly midway between the 7th letter from the left and the 17th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
q.x: The 7th letter is G and the 17th letter is Q. The middle position is (7+17)/2 = 12th letter, which is L.

q.q: In the sequence A, C, E, G, I, what is the next letter?
q.x: This is a sequence skipping one letter (A, B, C, D, E...). The next letter after I, skipping J, is K.

q.q: If the English alphabet is written in reverse order, which letter will be the 7th to the right of the 12th letter from the left?
q.x: In reverse order, the 12th letter from the left is O. The 7th to the right of O (moving towards the start of the alphabet) is F.

q.q: If every alternate letter in the word 'STRATEGIES' starting from the first is replaced by the next letter in the English alphabet, what will the new word be?
q.x: Replace 1st(S->T), 3rd(R->S), 5th(T->U), 7th(G->H), 9th(E->F). The string is T T S B U G H J F S. Applying carefully to indices 1,3,5,7,9: S+1=T, R+1=S, T+1=U, G+1=H, E+1=F. The result is TTRBTGJEIS.

q.q: Which letter is the 9th letter to the left of the 18th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
q.x: 18 - 9 = 9th letter. The 9th letter from the left is I.

q.q: If the word 'DIPLOMA' is arranged alphabetically, how many letters will remain at the same position?
q.x: Original: D I P L O M A. Sorted: A D I L M O P. Only 'L' remains in the 4th position.

q.q: How many pairs of letters are there in the word 'COMPUTER' which have as many letters between them in the word as in the English alphabet?
q.x: Checking the letters: C to E (one letter D in between, one in alphabet) and O to R (two letters P, Q in between, two in alphabet). Only these two pairs exist.

q.q: Which letter is exactly halfway between the 7th letter from the left and the 7th letter from the right in the English alphabet?
q.x: 7th from left is G. 7th from right is 27-7=20, which is T. The letters between G and T are H,I,J,K,L,M,N,O,P,Q,R,S. The middle is N.

q.q: If the first and second letters of the word 'INHERITANCE' are interchanged, and similarly the third and fourth, the fifth and sixth, and so on, which letter will be the seventh from the left?
q.x: The word is INHERITANCE. Swapping pairs gives: NI, RE, HI, TA, NC, E. The sequence becomes NIREHITANCE. The seventh letter is T.

q.q: In the word 'BACKGROUND', if all the vowels are changed to the next letter in the alphabet and all consonants are changed to the previous letter, what is the third letter from the right?
q.x: B-1=A, A+1=B, C-1=B, K-1=J, G-1=F, R-1=Q, O+1=P, U+1=V, N-1=M, D-1=C. String: ABBJFQ PVMC. 3rd from right is M.

q.q: In the word 'EXAMINATION', if all vowels are replaced by the next letter in the alphabet and all consonants are replaced by the previous letter, what will be the new word?
q.x: E(v)->F, X(c)->W, A(v)->B, M(c)->L, I(v)->J, N(c)->M, A(v)->B, T(c)->S, I(v)->J, O(v)->P, N(c)->M. Result: FWBLJMB SJ PM. Wait, recalculating: E+1=F, X-1=W, A+1=B, M-1=L, I+1=J, N-1=M, A+1=B, T-1=S, I+1=J, O+1=P, N-1=M. Result: FWBLJMB SJPM.

q.q: How many such pairs of letters are there in the word 'SEQUENCE' each of which has as many letters between them as in the English alphabet?
q.x: S to U (T in between) and Q to U (R, S, T in between). There are two pairs.

q.q: If every alternate letter starting from 'A' is deleted from the English alphabet, which letter will be the 5th to the left of the 10th letter from the right?
q.x: Remaining letters are B, D, F, H, J, L, N, P, R, T, V, X, Z. The 10th from the right is H, and moving 5 positions to the left leads to H itself in the sequence.

q.q: If the letters of the word 'COMPUTERS' are arranged in alphabetical order, how many letters remain at the same position?
q.x: Original: C O M P U T E R S. Sorted: C E M O P R S T U. Comparing index by index, no letter occupies its original position.

q.q: How many meaningful English words can be formed using the letters 'A', 'E', 'L', 'T' using each letter only once?
q.x: The letters A, E, L, T can form the words 'TALE', 'LATE', and 'TEAL'. Since the question asks for the count, 3 is the correct answer.

q.q: If the first and second halves of the English alphabet are reversed, which letter will be the 8th letter to the right of the 10th letter from the left?
q.x: The first half (A-M) becomes M-A and the second half (N-Z) becomes Z-N. The 10th letter from the left is D, and the 8th to the right is V.
